# QSPR (Abraham solute descriptor) environment — exact lockfile (resolves #38)
#
# Separate venv from env/ionisation-venv (#20) on purpose: chemprop_solvation is 2022-era
# code installed from a pinned git commit in editable mode, and pulls descriptastorus from
# git. Keeping it out of the ionisation lockfile means a break here cannot take the pKa
# provider down with it. The two share the same interpreter and the same rdkit/torch/numpy
# pins, so they are the same platform, not a competing one.
#
# Direct dependencies:
#   torch, rdkit, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, tqdm, tensorboardX, matplotlib
#                  — chemprop_solvation's runtime imports
#   descriptastorus — required for the `rdkit_2d_normalized` feature generator that the
#                     SoluteML checkpoints were trained with. Not on PyPI; pinned by commit.
#
# NOT listed here (installed separately by env/install_qspr.sh):
#   chemprop_solvation @ fhvermei/chemprop_solvation eb7f7d90fd064d9d939d27ba5837485af9a75295
#     installed editable from env/_src/ with env/patches/*.patch applied.
#   The pretrained 25-member ensemble: Zenodo record 5792296 v1.0.0, ML_model_files.zip.
#
# Resolved on: 2026-08-15, macOS arm64 (Darwin 24.5.0), Python 3.13.7
# Recreate with: bash env/install_qspr.sh
